recipe.visualDefinition: A central portrait of a man in a fringed western shirt and sunglasses, framed by a tilted, illustrated white doorway that is covered in hand-drawn piano keys and musical staff lines. The entire scene is bathed in a warm, sepia-reddish tint with a prominent header section containing ultra-condensed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a dynamic, tilted geometric frame
Contrast between realistic photography and hand-drawn musical motifs
Monochromatic color wash unifying disparate graphic elements
Heavy, condensed typography balanced by a thin horizontal rule
coreInvariants: Tilted white door frame with sketch-style piano keys
Ultra-condensed sans-serif display type at the top edge
Thin white horizontal line separating header from image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Mid-shot of the subject, centered horizontally, occupying the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and dark sunglasses serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large header text, move down the vertical lines of the door frame to the subject, and then follow the diagonal piano sketches.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The header area and the interior of the doorway provide breathing room against the busy sketch details.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia/terracotta wash over the entire image.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the door frame and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep black for the sunglasses, belt, and piano key sketches.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast between the white frame and the dark shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones, white, and black.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Circular dot used as a separator between words
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact, paired with a thin geometric line.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and clean sans-serif look.
Provides the necessary weight and density if horizontally scaled.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a photo of a man in a 1970s western fringed shirt and sunglasses, standing in a tilted white doorway. Apply a warm sepia-red color grade. Overlay hand-drawn, sketchy black piano keys and staff lines onto the white door frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of ultra-condensed white sans-serif text at the very top, separated from the image by a thin white horizontal line.

verificationChecks: Is the text ultra-condensed and uppercase?
Is there a thin white line separating the text from the photo?
Is the doorway tilted and covered in piano sketches?
Is the overall color palette monochromatic warm sepia?

adjustableVariables: Density of the piano key sketches
mustRedesign: Original artist name and album title
Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Clear distinction between the photo and the sketch elements
avoid: Modern digital filters that look artificial

postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of the thin horizontal rule
Ensure the piano keys look hand-sketched rather than clip-art
Confirm the sepia tone is consistent across all elements
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a sepia-toned central portrait with a tilted, illustrated architectural frame and top-aligned ultra-condensed display type.
